note: Hand-calculated cases for TP v0.1 definitions (Stage 0 Go/No-Go, ADR 0010). Each case's rationale is the hand calculation; tests/test_tp_examples.py checks stalker/tp/reference.py reproduces every expected value within tolerance.

assumptions.A-explicit-range: Opponent range given explicitly as weighted combos (TeacherContext stand-in); hidden cards never used
assumptions.A-uniform-prior: Uniform prior over live combos; posterior from the stated opponent line frequencies
assumptions.A-calling-range: My representative calling range given explicitly (TeacherContext: my policy)
assumptions.A-fold-policy: Opponent fold probability per combo for the presented size given explicitly
assumptions.A-icm-malmuth-harville: ICM = Malmuth-Harville; a player busted by this hand takes the next payout down; no blinds in the pot

cases.rationale: River. KK makes a set of kings and beats AA; QQ loses to AA. Equal weights: win 1/2, no ties.
Royal flush on the board: everyone plays the board, the pot splits two ways. win 0, tie 1, equity = 1/2 (split share).
44 unseen rivers (52-2-4-2). Hero wins with 9 hearts + 3 aces (As Ac Ad) + 3 kings (Ks Kc Kd) = 15 -> 15/44. No straight is possible for hero with one card.
Multiway (2 opponents), all play the board: three-way split, hero share 1/3.

Opponent takes the line with pairs only. As blocks 3 of 6 AA combos, Kd 3 of 6 KK. Live pair combos 13*6-3-3 = 72, so P(AA) = 3/72. AKo: 12 combos minus 3 with As minus 3 with Kd plus AsKd counted twice -> 7 live; AKs: AsKs, AdKd blocked -> 2 live.
Blocker case: AKs shows 100 but As leaves only 3 live AKs combos (AsKs gone) and 9 live AKo (AsKc AsKd AsKh gone). Mixed AKo at 50% shows 50.
Same 169 display as the previous case (AKs 100, AKo 50) but no blockers: 4 and 12 live combos. The UI must show the live count.
My range AA wins against QQ, loses to KK (set): equity 1/2, board.adv = 100*(1-1/2) = 50.
Pairs: AA>55, AA>QQ, 88>55, 88<QQ -> 3/4 equity, board.adv = 25.
Equity now 15/44 = 34.1%. The 15 winning rivers move equity to 100% (+65.9pp >= +10pp). Qc Qd cannot come (opponent holds them), so 44 equally likely rivers: outs = 15/44*100.
AA vs a set of kings. Only As or Ac on the turn helps (set over set, then wins unless Kh: 43/44). 45 unseen turn cards -> 2/45*100 = 4.44.
The other 29 rivers drop equity from 34.1% to 0 (-34.1pp <= -10pp): 29/44*100.
Equity now = runouts with an ace and no Kh: (2*42 + 1)/990 = 8.6%. No card can drop it by 10pp, so vuln = 0. This is why hand.outs and hand.vuln are separate: an average change would hide it.
Against my calls AA and 98 (pair of nines): KK beats both (100%, value); QQ beats 98, loses to AA (exactly 50%, not > 50% -> bluff side); 54 loses to both. Value share 1/3.
Same bet range; if I only call with 98, QQ becomes value too: 2/3. opp.value is relative to my calling range, so the assumption must be shown.
Opponent 1 folds 2/3, opponent 2 folds 0.6, independent: all fold = 2/3 * 0.6 = 0.4.
Heads-up for everything: win 70, lose 30, fold 50 -> ICM required (50-30)/(70-30) = 50% = chip-EV required 1000/2000. Premium 0.

Three 1000 stacks, villain shoves. Fold: all equal -> 33.33. Win: hero 2000 vs 1000 for 50/30 -> 2/3*50 + 1/3*30 = 43.33. Lose: hero busts 3rd -> 20. ICM required (33.33-20)/(43.33-20) = 4/7 = 57.14%; chip-EV 50%. Premium 7.14pp.
